title: JSON Web Token (JWT) Claims Set and JOSE Header
description: Schemas for the decoded JOSE Header and JWT Claims Set of a JSON Web Token, as defined in RFC 7519 (JWT) and RFC 7515 (JWS). Covers registered header parameters and registered claim names; additional public and private claims are permitted.

numericDate.description: RFC 7519 Section 2: seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z UTC, ignoring leap seconds. Non-integer values are allowed.

stringOrURI.description: RFC 7519 Section 2: an arbitrary string, which MUST be a URI if it contains a ':' character.

alg.description: Algorithm used to secure the JWT (RFC 7515 Section 4.1.1). 'none' indicates an Unsecured JWT.

typ.description: Media type of the complete JWT; 'JWT' is recommended (RFC 7519 Section 5.1).

cty.description: Content type; 'JWT' for nested JWTs (RFC 7519 Section 5.2).

x5c.description: X.509 certificate chain, base64-encoded DER (RFC 7515 Section 4.1.6).

x5t.description: X.509 certificate SHA-1 thumbprint, base64url (RFC 7515 Section 4.1.7).

x5t#S256.description: X.509 certificate SHA-256 thumbprint, base64url (RFC 7515 Section 4.1.8).

crit.description: Critical header parameters that must be understood (RFC 7515 Section 4.1.11).

claimsSet.description: JWT Claims Set (RFC 7519 Section 4). All registered claims are optional; public and private claims are allowed.

aud.description: Audience: a single StringOrURI or an array of them (RFC 7519 Section 4.1.3).

jti.description: JWT ID, a unique identifier (RFC 7519 Section 4.1.7).
